avis.titre: Gentle on Skin and lightens brown spotsGentle on Skin and lightens brown spots
avis.texte: 5/5 Stars: Finally Found Toner Pads That Deliver Real Results At 53, I've been using Retin-A consistently for over 20 years and have tested countless skincare products. These JIYU Toner Pads genuinely impressed me—a rare compliment from someone with serious skincare experience. What Works: Living in Hawaii means constant sun exposure, and despite religious daily sunscreen use, I've dealt with stubborn brown spots and age-related dullness. These pads have visibly brightened my complexion in just a few weeks. The difference is noticeable, especially on areas that tend to look dull and damaged from UV exposure. The Best Part: They're powerful and gentle. As someone whose skin is primed for sensitivity (thanks to decades of Retin-A), I was cautious. These haven't irritated my skin or compromised my barrier—they've actually enhanced it. The combination of snail mucin, niacinamide, peptides, and centella works. You can feel the quality. The Value: 100 count means real longevity. They're becoming a non-negotiable part of my routine—morning and evening. For anyone dealing with sun damage, age spots, or that flat, tired look that comes with decades of sun exposure, these are legitimately worth trying. If you're skeptical about toner pads, I get it. I was too. But these proved me wrong.

avis.titre: Not bad - functional - but maybe a bit expensive.

The pads are suppose to be thin as when I first used them - they stuck together despite the small tongs included in the product - I was picking up two to three pads at a time. For my face, I couldn't really tell but it seemed brighter - I also use a vitamin C serum too. Depending on price, I would buy again.

avis.titre: Great Packaging and Easy to Use, Still Waiting on Results
avis.texte: I really like the JiYu Toning Polish Pads overall, especially for the packaging and how easy they are to use in my skincare routine. The container feels very clean and well-designed, and I love that it comes with tweezers. It might sound like a small thing, but it actually makes a big difference for me. Being able to grab a pad without using my fingers feels more hygienic and just more convenient, especially when I’m doing my skincare quickly at night. The pads themselves are easy to use and feel gentle on my skin. They don’t leave my face feeling stripped or overly dry, which I appreciate. They slide smoothly over the skin and fit nicely into my routine without any irritation. That being said, I’m still not completely sure how much they’re actually improving my skin long-term. I haven’t noticed any dramatic changes yet, but I also haven’t had any negative reactions. My skin feels fine after using them, just not significantly different at this point. I think this is one of those products that may need more consistent use over time to really see results. For now, I mostly appreciate the convenience, the packaging, and how simple it is to incorporate into my routine. Overall, I do like them and will keep using them for now, but I’m still waiting to see if they make a noticeable difference in my skin.

This seems to be working but very slowly. It’s been a month already. The spots on my face seem to fading but I can tell you it is nothing like they put on TikTok etc. My skin isn’t getting smoother. Those influencers are using filters! Don’t be fooled. It is a very slow process and it will take more than one of these very expensive jars to complete the deed. People make comments that it tingles and feels refreshing after use, it does not. It’s just like wipes. Be sure to rube rigorously into your skin and don’t apply any moisturizer for at least 15 to 20 mins. Give the product time to work. Make sure to wash your face thoroughly first. I do it once a day. Today I looked at my picture I took over a month ago prior to the purchase and then again today, it is definitely lightening the spots as I mentioned but it is extremely slow. Be prepared to go broke on this! lol. This is an honest review from a consumer just like you looking for answers. I hope I was sent the authentic product. Looks like it though and I make sure to research first and bought it here on Amazon instead of TikTok etc. There are a lot of fake ones out there so take caution.

This is my 2nd bottle meaning I did see some lightning but no change in my skin texture. I also still had breakouts. I like the way my face feels after using, its a cool clean & refreshed feeling. This order came with only 1 seal inside (differ seal) also smells stronger (I cant put my finger on the smell at this time but its familiar). I found the tweezers a mth after I realized its supposed to have them they were not attached to the lid. I have incorporated this into my daily skin care but will make adjustments if no improvement in texture, breakouts & hyperpigmentation. I think this product should be less expensive but then again u do get a 3 mth supply. Cheaper on tik tok but slower delivery.

avis.titre: Game-Changer for Dark Spots and Dull Skin – Loving These K-Beauty Pads!
avis.texte: I’ve been dealing with stubborn dark spots from old acne and sun damage (I’m in my 40s, combo skin that’s prone to dullness), and these JiYu Toning Polish Pads have seriously impressed me after about 3-4 weeks of consistent use. The pads are thick, generously soaked (no dry ones at the bottom of the jar!), and have a subtle refreshing eucalyptus-like scent that’s not overpowering. They feel mildly exfoliating thanks to the gentle acids/formula, but super soothing at the same time – no stinging, redness, or dryness, even on sensitive areas. I swipe one over my face and neck after cleansing (morning and night), and it instantly makes my skin feel smoother, more hydrated, and brighter. The glow is real – people have asked if I got a facial! Key wins for me: • Dark spots (especially on cheeks and forehead) are noticeably fading and less intense. • Skin texture is smoother, pores look smaller, and overall tone is more even. • Fine lines around my eyes and mouth seem softer – the snail mucin, niacinamide, peptides, centella, and alpha-arbutin combo really delivers hydration + brightening without being harsh. • Great for daily use; no purging or breakouts (actually calmed some redness). Only tiny downside: If you have very sensitive skin, start with once a day to test, but I had zero issues. Highly recommend if you’re chasing that clear, glowy Korean skincare look and targeting dark spots/wrinkles/dullness. These are staying in my routine!

You get a lot of pads, yes, it’s a bit expensive but it works so I’m ok with it as I really want to get rid of my hyperpigmentation to have a more even tone throughout my body.
